newsitem.title: UK: BA appoints new cargo sales & marketing GM.
newsitem.headline: BA appoints new cargo sales & marketing GM.

text.p: British Airways World Cargo (BAWC) said Monday it had appointed Geoff Corpe to the newly-created role of general manager worldwide sales and marketing.
Corpe joins the BA subsidiary at the year's end and will be based at Heathrow where he will report to BAWC managing director Kevin Hatton.

Previously he was executive director of MSAS Cargo International and also held the posts of UK managing director, executive director Far East and South Pacific, and president of Air Link USA and Hong Kong.

Corpe "will be the voice of the consumer within our business and fully embraces the need for tripartite relationship building between the consumer, forwarderd and carrier," Hatton said in a statement.

And "he has a clear understanding of the entuire supply cvhain, especially the role of electronic data interchange and bar coding and the need to eradicate inefficient processes which will deliver benefits for our customers and the airline."

Corfe said the programme of change going through the industry will help it realise its full potential and that he is looking forward to "developing the close working partnership World Cargo must have with its freight forwarding customers in order to fulfill the requirements of everyone in the supply chain." - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
